content.text: Citibank has traditionally reinforced its commitment to social welfare by promoting educational programs over the last decade. In keeping with this commitment, Citibank has contributed Rs.1 million to the Aga Khan University's (AKU) Medical College. This funding will complement AKU's effort towards covering tuition fees for medical students who are unable to finance their education. Citibank has in recent years assisted various prestigious educational institutions by providing financial assistance as well as teachers who are experienced bankers.

The Aga Khan University Is a component of the Aga Khan Development Network whose mission is social development in developing countries currently, the University provides opportunities for development of skilled manpower in health care and teacher education. The University's purpose is to develop individuals for competence and leadership in their fields of study and training. The university strives for quality, international standards and relevance in all of its programs.

Though its financial assistance programme, the University ensures that no Pakistan citizen resident in Pakistan, who is otherwise qualified for admission to the medical college or the school of nursing is excluded solely because of inability to pay tuition. Admissions to AKU are on the basis of merit, irrespective of economic status, gender, race, religion or domicile.
During the 1998-1999 academic years, more than one third of the students enrolled were given financial assistance in the form of loans. Scholarships and granting-aid from the University.
